module Data.Monoid.Reducer
newtype WithReducer c m Source
If m is a c-Reducer — unavailable from the original server (HTTP 404), then m is (c WithReducer m)-Reducer — unavailable from the original server (HTTP 404) This can be used to quickly select a Reducer — unavailable from the original server (HTTP 404) for use as a FingerTree measure.
